otp_codes_person_by_purpose.name: otp_codes_person_by_purpose
otp_codes_person_by_purpose.value: ("otp_codes"."purpose" = 'login' AND "otp_codes"."person_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("otp_codes"."purpose" = 'signup' AND "otp_codes"."person_id" IS NULL)

otp_codes_pending_by_purpose.name: otp_codes_pending_by_purpose
otp_codes_pending_by_purpose.value: ("otp_codes"."purpose" = 'signup' AND "otp_codes"."pending_signup" IS NOT NULL) OR ("otp_codes"."purpose" = 'login' AND "otp_codes"."pending_signup" IS NULL)

people_client_requires_conversion.name: people_client_requires_conversion
people_client_requires_conversion.value: "people"."status" <> 'client' OR ("people"."converted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "people"."conversion_reason" IS NOT NULL)
